description: A count or dot pinned to the top-inline-end corner of whatever it wraps — notifications on a bell, unread on an avatar. Distinct from <Badge>, which is a standalone status pill. Hidden entirely when count is 0 and no dot. Copy: the accessible label counts the thing, not the badge — "3 unread messages". A number alone is read as "three" with nothing to attach it to.

props.name: children
props.description: The element the marker sits on (an Icon, IconButton, Avatar).

props.name: count
props.description: Numeric count. Values over `max` render as `${max}+`. Omit for a plain dot.

props.name: dot
props.description: Show a small dot with no number (e.g. "unread", "online").

props.name: label
props.description: Read out to a screen reader, e.g. "3 unread". Without it the marker is decorative (aria-hidden) — pass it whenever the count carries meaning.

example:
<Row gap={6} align="center">
  <CountBadge count={5} label="5 unread messages">
    <Tooltip content="Messages">
      <IconButton icon="message" aria-label="Messages" />
    </Tooltip>
  </CountBadge>
  <CountBadge count={2} tone="danger" label="2 failed jobs">
    <Tooltip content="Jobs">
      <IconButton icon="progress_activity" aria-label="Jobs" />
    </Tooltip>
  </CountBadge>
  
  <CountBadge dot label="New activity">
    <Tooltip content="Activity">
      <IconButton icon="history" aria-label="Activity" />
    </Tooltip>
  </CountBadge>
</Row>
